name: @mbse/codegen-python
description: Schemas as idiomatic Python source and back: mbse-schemas' schemas rendered as dataclasses through mbse-programs' syntax trees, step by step, by mbse-patterns' transforms (TypeScript implementation)

scripts.postinstall: python3 ../scripts/siblings.py check && npm --prefix ../../mbse-schemas/typescript5 install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix ../../mbse-expressions/typescript5 install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix ../../mbse-patterns/typescript5 install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix ../../mbse-programs/typescript5 install --no-audit --no-fund
